scenario.name: CISA AA22-103A, Dragos PIPEDREAM & Mandiant INCONTROLLER — Industrial PLC CODESYS & Modbus/OPC-UA Protocol Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine a saboteur sneaking onto a power plant floor with a Swiss-army toolbox built for three different factory machines. First, they walk the control hallway scanning every dial plate to catalog each machine model. Next, they slide a forged maintenance cartridge into the main assembly controller to rewrite its operating instructions, and finally they twist the raw manual pressure valves directly on the pipe manifold while floor monitors log every unauthorized turn. In this scenario (T1046, CISA AA22-103A, Dragos PIPEDREAM & Mandiant INCONTROLLER, Industrial PLC CODESYS & Modbus/OPC-UA Protocol Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: industrial Asset Discovery via OPC-UA, then cODESYS v2/v3 Runtime Authentication Bypass, then direct Modbus TCP Register Write. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Industrial Asset Discovery via OPC-UA, then CODESYS v2/v3 Runtime Authentication Bypass, then Direct Modbus TCP Register Write, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates process, authentication, and network telemetry for T1046 across the documented kill chain.

stages.subtitle: Discovery (T1046 - Network Service Discovery / ICS Asset Enumeration)
stages.description: Starting from a hijacked supervisor console on the plant floor, the saboteur pulls out the scouting gauge from the Swiss-army toolbox and walks past every controller rack, knocking on each inspection window so the machines proudly announce their make, model, and firmware badge. Under the hood, the observed step executes zeek -C -r ot-capture.pcap icsnpp-opcua-binary icsnpp-modbus (which Captures or inspects industrial control system , ICS/OT protocol frames and engineering workstation logs , zeek -C -r ot-capture.pcap icsnpp-opcua so that reconstructs PLC logic transfers, substation breaker telecontrol commands, or Safety Instrumented System , SIS controller state changes , T1046 during "Industrial Asset Discovery via OPC-UA , Port 4840 & ENIP/Modbus Enumeration , TAGRUN"). stages.title: Stage 3: Direct Modbus TCP Register Write (Function Code 06/16) & Physical Switch Verification
stages.subtitle: Impact (T1565.002 - Data Manipulation: Transmitted Data / PLC Register Write)
